import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static final long MINF = Long.MIN_VALUE;
    static final long MOD_A = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_B = 1000000007L;
    static long totalN;
    static long totalCount;
    static long[] prefixSumArr = new long[7];
    static List<Long>[] prefixDigitsArr = new ArrayList[7];
    static long counter2 = -1;
    static long finalAns = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            prefixDigitsArr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static boolean isPrimeNumber(long x) {
        if (x < 2) return false;
        long sqrtX = (long) Math.sqrt(x);
        for (long i = 2; i <= sqrtX; i++) {
            if (x % i == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static long readLongLong(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        long x = 0;
        int f = 1;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (!Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                if (ch == '-') f = -1;
                else continue;
            } else {
                do {
                    x = x * 10 + (ch - '0');
                    ch = br.read();
                } while (ch != -1 && Character.isDigit(ch));
                break;
            }
        }
        return x * f;
    }

    static long computeGCD(long a, long b) {
        return b == 0 ? a : computeGCD(b, a % b);
    }

    static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * base % mod;
            base = base * base % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void generateNumbers(int depth, long current) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        long val = (totalCount - current + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        prefixDigitsArr[depth].add(val);
        prefixSumArr[depth] += val;
        totalCount++;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generateNumbers(depth + 1, current * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static void processNumbers(int depth, long current, long N) {
        if (current > N) return;
        if (current * 1000000 + 999999 <= N && current * 10000000 > N) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long shift = (counter2 + 1 - current * modPow(10, i, MOD_A) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                List<Long> arr = prefixDigitsArr[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(arr, MOD_A - shift);
                long sumPart = prefixSumArr[i] + shift * arr.size() - MOD_A * (arr.size() - pos);
                finalAns = (finalAns + sumPart) % MOD_B;
            }
            counter2 += totalCount;
            return;
        }
        counter2++;
        long addVal = ((counter2 - current) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        finalAns = (finalAns + addVal) % MOD_B;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            if (depth == 0 && d == 0) continue;
            processNumbers(depth + 1, current * 10 + d, N);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) high = mid;
            else low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        totalN = readLongLong(br);
        generateNumbers(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(prefixDigitsArr[i]);
        }
        processNumbers(0, 0, totalN);
        System.out.println(finalAns);
    }
}
